column1: The extinct thylacine, also known as the Tasmanian tiger, was a marsupial* that bore a superficial resemblance to a dog.
column2: 已经灭绝的袋狼也叫塔斯马尼亚虎，是一种有袋类哺乳动物*，外表看起来有点像狗。
column7: bore a superficial resemblance to|外表与……略为相似

column1: Its most distinguishing feature was the 13–19 dark brown stripes over its back, beginning at the rear of the body and extending onto the tail.
column2: 它最容易辨认的特征是背上的13至19条深褐色条纹，从身体后部一直延伸到尾巴上。

column1: The thylacine’s average nose-to-tail length for adult males was 162.6 cm, compared to 153.7 cm for females.
column2: 成年雄袋狼从鼻尖至尾尖的平均长度为162.6厘米，雌袋狼则为153.7厘米。
column4: nose-to-tail length|鼻尖至尾尖的长度

column1: The thylacine appeared to occupy most types of terrain except dense rainforest, with open eucalyptus forest thought to be its prime habitat.
column2: 除茂密的雨林外，袋狼似乎能在大多数类型的地形中生活；人们认为，其主要栖息地是较为开阔的桉树林。

column1: In terms of feeding, it was exclusively carnivorous, and its stomach was muscular with an ability to distend so that it could eat large amounts of food at one time, probably an adaptation to compensate for long periods when hunting was unsuccessful and food scarce.
column2: 就食性而言，袋狼完全以肉为食。它的胃肌肉发达、能够扩张，一次就能吃下大量食物。这很可能是一种适应，使它能应付长时间捕猎无果、食物匮乏的情况。

column1: The thylacine was not a fast runner and probably caught its prey by exhausting it during a long pursuit.
column2: 袋狼跑得不快，大概是靠长时间追逐，把猎物拖得精疲力竭后才将其捕获。

column1: During long-distance chases, thylacines were likely to have relied more on scent than any other sense.
column2: 在长距离追逐中，袋狼很可能比起其他任何感官都更依赖嗅觉。

column1: They emerged to hunt during the evening, night and early morning and tended to retreat to the hills and forest for shelter during the day.
column2: 它们在傍晚、夜间和清晨出来捕猎，白天通常会退回山丘和森林里藏身。

column1: Despite the common name ‘tiger’, the thylacine had a shy, nervous temperament.
column2: 尽管俗名里带个“虎”字，袋狼的性情却胆怯而敏感。

column1: Although mainly nocturnal, it was sighted moving during the day and some individuals were even recorded basking in the sun.
column2: 袋狼虽然以夜间活动为主，也有人见过它在白天活动；甚至还有个别袋狼晒太阳的记录。

column1: The thylacine had an extended breeding season from winter to spring, with indications that some breeding took place throughout the year.
column2: 袋狼的繁殖季很长，从冬季延续到春季，也有迹象表明，一年中各个时候都可能发生繁殖。

column1: The thylacine, like all marsupials, was tiny and hairless when born.
column2: 与所有有袋类动物一样，袋狼出生时体型很小，身上没有毛。

column1: Newborns crawled into the pouch on the belly of their mother, and attached themselves to one of the four teats, remaining there for up to three months.
column2: 幼崽出生后爬进母兽腹部的育儿袋，吸住四个乳头中的一个，最长会在那里待上三个月。

column1: When old enough to leave the pouch, the young stayed in a lair such as a deep rocky cave, well-hidden nest or hollow log, whilst the mother hunted.
column2: 当幼崽长大到能离开育儿袋时，母兽外出捕猎期间，它们就待在窝里，比如幽深的岩洞、隐蔽的巢穴或中空的树干。

column1: Approximately 4,000 years ago, the thylacine was widespread throughout New Guinea and most of mainland Australia, as well as the island of Tasmania.
column2: 大约4,000年前，袋狼广泛分布于新几内亚、澳大利亚大陆大部分地区以及塔斯马尼亚岛。

column1: The most recent, well-dated occurrence of a thylacine on the mainland is a carbon-dated fossil from Murray Cave in Western Australia, which is around 3,100 years old.
column2: 在澳大利亚大陆能可靠定年的袋狼记录中，最晚的一例是西澳大利亚州默里洞穴出土的一件化石，放射性碳测年显示它距今约3,100年。
column7: carbon-dated|adj. 经放射性碳测年的

column1: Its extinction coincided closely with the arrival of wild dogs called dingoes in Australia and a similar predator in New Guinea.
column2: 袋狼的灭绝时间与两件事十分接近：澳洲野犬这种野狗抵达澳大利亚，以及一种近似的捕食者抵达新几内亚。
column4: coincided closely with|与……在时间上十分接近

column1: Dingoes never reached Tasmania, and most scientists see this as the main reason for the thylacine’s survival there.
column2: 澳洲野犬从未到达塔斯马尼亚，多数科学家认为，这就是袋狼能在那里存活下来的主要原因。

column1: The dramatic decline of the thylacine in Tasmania, which began in the 1830s and continued for a century, is generally attributed to the relentless efforts of sheep farmers and bounty hunters** with shotguns.
column2: 塔斯马尼亚的袋狼数量从19世纪30年代开始急剧下降，这种情况持续了一个世纪。人们普遍将其归因于牧羊农户和赏金猎人**持猎枪不懈捕杀。

column1: While this determined campaign undoubtedly played a large part, it is likely that various other factors also contributed to the decline and eventual extinction of the species.
column2: 这场持续不懈的捕杀无疑是一个重要原因，但袋狼数量减少乃至最终灭绝，很可能还有其他多种因素在起作用。
column5: played a large part|起了重要作用

column1: These include competition with wild dogs introduced by European settlers, loss of habitat along with the disappearance of prey species, and a distemper-like disease which may also have affected the thylacine.
column2: 这些因素包括与欧洲移民带来的野狗竞争、栖息地丧失和猎物物种消失，以及一种也可能影响了袋狼的类似犬瘟热的疾病。

column1: There was only one successful attempt to breed a thylacine in captivity, at Melbourne Zoo in 1899.
column2: 圈养条件下繁育袋狼只成功过一次，那是1899年在墨尔本动物园。

column1: This was despite the large numbers that went through some zoos, particularly London Zoo and Tasmania’s Hobart Zoo.
column2: 尽管有些动物园先后饲养过许多袋狼，特别是伦敦动物园和塔斯马尼亚的霍巴特动物园，成功记录仍只有这一次。
column5: went through|先后经过；曾被某处收养

column1: The famous naturalist John Gould foresaw the thylacine’s demise when he published his Mammals of Australia between 1848 and 1863, writing, ‘The numbers of this singular animal will speedily diminish, extermination will have its full sway, and it will then, like the wolf of England and Scotland, be recorded as an animal of the past.’
column2: 著名博物学家约翰·古尔德于1848年至1863年间出版《澳大利亚哺乳动物》时，已预见到袋狼的消亡。他写道：“这种独特动物的数量将很快减少，终究难逃灭绝；到那时，它将像英格兰和苏格兰的狼一样，成为载于史册的往昔动物。”
column10: have its full sway|完全占据上风

column1: However, there seems to have been little public pressure to preserve the thylacine, nor was much concern expressed by scientists at the decline of this species in the decades that followed.
column2: 然而，公众要求保护袋狼的压力似乎很小，在接下来的几十年中，科学家也很少对这一物种的衰退表示担忧。

column1: A notable exception was T.T. Flynn, Professor of Biology at the University of Tasmania.
column2: 塔斯马尼亚大学生物学教授T.T. 弗林，是一个值得一提的例外。
column6: University of Tasmania|塔斯马尼亚大学

column1: In 1914, he was sufficiently concerned about the scarcity of the thylacine to suggest that some should be captured and placed on a small island.
column2: 1914年，他对袋狼日渐稀少深感担忧，因此建议捕捉一些袋狼，把它们安置在一座小岛上。

column1: But it was not until 1929, with the species on the very edge of extinction, that Tasmania’s Animals and Birds Protection Board passed a motion protecting thylacines only for the month of December, which was thought to be their prime breeding season.
column2: 然而，直到1929年，袋狼已濒临灭绝时，塔斯马尼亚动物与鸟类保护委员会才通过一项动议，仅在12月份保护袋狼，因为当时人们认为12月是它们主要的繁殖期。
column6: passed a motion|通过一项动议

column1: The last known wild thylacine to be killed was shot by a farmer in the north-east of Tasmania in 1930, leaving just captive specimens.
column2: 已知最后一只遭猎杀的野生袋狼，于1930年在塔斯马尼亚东北部被一名农户射杀，从此仅剩圈养个体。

column1: Official protection of the species by the Tasmanian government was introduced in July 1936, 59 days before the last known individual died in Hobart Zoo on 7th September, 1936.
column2: 塔斯马尼亚政府于1936年7月正式对该物种实施保护。59天后，1936年9月7日，已知最后一只袋狼死于霍巴特动物园。
column7: last known individual|已知最后一个个体

column1: There have been numerous expeditions and searches for the thylacine over the years, none of which has produced definitive evidence that thylacines still exist.
column2: 多年来，人们组织过多次探查和搜寻，但没有一次找到袋狼仍然存在的确凿证据。

column1: The species was declared extinct by the Tasmanian government in 1986.
column2: 1986年，塔斯马尼亚政府宣布该物种已经灭绝。
